fields.name: source port
fields.description: if meaningful, indicates the port of the sending process, and may be assumed to be the port to which a reply should be addressed in the absence of any other information. if not used, a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: the port of the destination process.

fields.name: length
fields.description: total length of the udp packet including header and data.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of a pseudo header and udp data.

parsing context.name: ip header
parsing context.description: assumes that the internet protocol (ip) is used as the underlying protocol.
